definition: facts or details that tell you something about a subject (information on + something)
exampleSentence: You can find more information on our website.
exampleTranslation: Bạn có thể tìm thêm thông tin trên trang web của chúng tôi.

definition: a sudden clear understanding of something or part of something (insight into + something)
exampleSentence: The article gives us a real insight into the causes of the economic crisis.
exampleTranslation: Bài báo cho chúng ta cái nhìn sâu sắc về nguyên nhân của cuộc khủng hoảng kinh tế.

definition: a plan or wish to do something (intention of + -ing)
exampleSentence: I have no intention of retiring just yet.
exampleTranslation: Tôi chưa có ý định nghỉ hưu.

definition: a feeling of wanting to know more about someone or something (interest in + something/-ing)
exampleSentence: My parents encouraged my interest in science.
exampleTranslation: Bố mẹ khuyến khích niềm yêu thích khoa học của tôi.

definition: something that explains the basic facts of a subject (introduction to + subject)
translation: phần giới thiệu về, nhập môn
exampleSentence: The book is a useful introduction to British geology.
exampleTranslation: Cuốn sách là phần nhập môn hữu ích về địa chất nước Anh.

definition: when the army of one country enters another country by force (invasion of + place)
exampleSentence: The invasion of Normandy began in June 1944.
exampleTranslation: Cuộc đổ bộ Normandy bắt đầu vào tháng 6 năm 1944.

definition: a spoken or written request asking someone to go somewhere or do something (invitation to + something)
exampleSentence: Roger never turns down an invitation to dinner.
exampleTranslation: Roger không bao giờ từ chối lời mời ăn tối.

definition: the act of taking part in an activity or event (involvement in + something)
exampleSentence: His new book examines the United States' involvement in World War II.
exampleTranslation: Cuốn sách mới của ông xem xét sự tham gia của Hoa Kỳ vào Thế chiến II.

definition: an occasion when you travel from one place to another (journey to + place)
exampleSentence: I wrote a diary during my journey to China.
exampleTranslation: Tôi viết nhật ký trong chuyến đi đến Trung Quốc.

definition: a small piece of metal that opens a lock, or the most important thing needed to achieve something (key to + something)
exampleSentence: I can lend you a spare key to the store.
exampleTranslation: Tôi có thể cho bạn mượn chìa khóa dự phòng của cửa hàng.

definition: the information, skills and understanding you have gained (knowledge of + something)
exampleSentence: He did not have much knowledge of American history.
exampleTranslation: Anh ấy không có nhiều kiến thức về lịch sử Mỹ.

definition: when there is not enough of something, or none of it (lack of + something)
exampleSentence: New parents often suffer from lack of sleep.
exampleTranslation: Các bậc cha mẹ mới thường bị thiếu ngủ.

definition: a period of time in which someone is taught a particular skill (lesson in + something)
exampleSentence: She takes lessons in first aid.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy học các bài về sơ cứu.

definition: a written message that is usually sent in an envelope (letter to + somebody)
exampleSentence: Bart is writing a letter to his parents.
exampleTranslation: Bart đang viết thư gửi bố mẹ.

definition: the amount or degree of something compared to another amount (level of + something)
exampleSentence: Dolphins show a high level of intelligence.
exampleTranslation: Cá heo có mức độ thông minh cao.

definition: the greatest or least amount that is allowed (limit on + something)
exampleSentence: My wife and I set a limit on how much we spend on clothes.
exampleTranslation: Vợ chồng tôi đặt ra giới hạn về số tiền chi cho quần áo.

definition: a way in which two things or ideas are related (link between + two things)
exampleSentence: Researchers study the link between drug use and crime.
exampleTranslation: Các nhà nghiên cứu tìm hiểu mối liên hệ giữa việc dùng ma túy và tội phạm.

definition: a relationship or connection with another person, country or organization (link with + somebody/something)
exampleSentence: The company has strong links with big investors.
exampleTranslation: Công ty có mối liên hệ chặt chẽ với các nhà đầu tư lớn.

definition: a set of names, numbers or things written one below the other (list of + things)
exampleSentence: Make a list of all the things you have to do.
exampleTranslation: Hãy lập danh sách tất cả những việc bạn phải làm.

definition: the fact of no longer having something, or having less of it (loss of + something)
exampleSentence: The court awarded her compensation for damages and loss of earnings.
exampleTranslation: Tòa án trao cho cô ấy khoản bồi thường cho thiệt hại và mất thu nhập.

definition: a strong feeling of pleasure and enjoyment that something gives you (love of + something)
exampleSentence: She has a great love of nature.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy rất yêu thiên nhiên.

definition: a strong feeling of caring about someone, especially a family member (love for + somebody)
exampleSentence: A mother's love for her child is very strong.
exampleTranslation: Tình yêu của người mẹ dành cho con rất mạnh mẽ.

definition: a planned way of doing something (method of + -ing/something)
exampleSentence: Modern methods of birth control give couples more choice.
exampleTranslation: Các phương pháp ngừa thai hiện đại giúp các cặp đôi có nhiều lựa chọn hơn.

definition: something that has been done in the wrong way (mistake in + something)
exampleSentence: We may have made a mistake in our calculations.
exampleTranslation: Có thể chúng ta đã sai trong phép tính.

definition: a situation in which something is necessary (need for + something)
exampleSentence: There is a growing need for new housing in many rural areas.
exampleTranslation: Nhu cầu về nhà ở mới đang tăng ở nhiều vùng nông thôn.

definition: information about something that has happened recently (news of + event)
exampleSentence: Everyone is shocked by the news of the arrests.
exampleTranslation: Mọi người đều sốc trước tin về các vụ bắt giữ.

definition: information about something that has happened recently (news about + somebody/something)
exampleSentence: Have you heard the terrible news about Simon?
exampleTranslation: Bạn đã nghe tin khủng khiếp về Simon chưa?

definition: an amount of something that can be counted (number of + things)
exampleSentence: The number of cars on our roads rose dramatically last year.
exampleTranslation: Số lượng xe trên đường của chúng ta tăng mạnh vào năm ngoái.

definition: the purpose of a plan, action or activity (object of + something)
exampleSentence: The object of the game is to improve children's math skills.
exampleTranslation: Mục đích của trò chơi là cải thiện kỹ năng toán của trẻ.

definition: something that makes it difficult to achieve something (obstacle to + something)
exampleSentence: Fear of change is an obstacle to progress.
exampleTranslation: Nỗi sợ thay đổi là trở ngại cho sự tiến bộ.

definition: a statement saying you are willing to do or give something (offer of + something)
exampleSentence: I can't turn down the offer of a free trip to Milan!
exampleTranslation: Tôi không thể từ chối lời đề nghị đi Milan miễn phí!

definition: your ideas or beliefs about a subject (opinion about + something)
exampleSentence: The two women had very different opinions about drugs.
exampleTranslation: Hai người phụ nữ có ý kiến rất khác nhau về ma túy.

definition: what you think of someone or something (opinion of + somebody/something)
exampleSentence: What is your opinion of Cathy?
exampleTranslation: Bạn nghĩ gì về Cathy?

definition: your ideas or beliefs about a particular subject (opinion on + something)
exampleSentence: He asked his wife's opinion on every important decision.
exampleTranslation: Anh ấy hỏi ý kiến vợ về mọi quyết định quan trọng.

definition: a chance to do something (opportunity for + something)
exampleSentence: Games and songs provide an opportunity for classroom interaction.
exampleTranslation: Trò chơi và bài hát tạo cơ hội để tương tác trong lớp học.

definition: strong disagreement with something such as a plan (opposition to + something)
exampleSentence: There was a great deal of opposition to the war.
exampleTranslation: Đã có rất nhiều sự phản đối cuộc chiến.

definition: the place or situation in which something begins to exist (origin of + something)
exampleSentence: Scientists have a new theory about the origin of the universe.
exampleTranslation: Các nhà khoa học có giả thuyết mới về nguồn gốc của vũ trụ.

definition: a very strong liking for something (passion for + something)
exampleSentence: He has a passion for football.
exampleTranslation: Anh ấy có niềm đam mê bóng đá.

definition: the act of paying for something (payment for + something)
exampleSentence: We received payment for the goods last week.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi đã nhận thanh toán cho lô hàng vào tuần trước.

definition: sympathy for someone who is suffering or unhappy (pity for + somebody)
exampleSentence: He looked exhausted, but Marie felt no pity for him.
exampleTranslation: Anh ấy trông kiệt sức, nhưng Marie không thấy thương hại anh.

definition: a set of actions for achieving something in the future (plan for + something)
exampleSentence: The chairman outlined the company's plans for growth.
exampleTranslation: Chủ tịch trình bày kế hoạch tăng trưởng của công ty.

definition: the purpose or aim of something (point of + something/-ing)
exampleSentence: What is the point of this meeting anyway?
exampleTranslation: Mà cuộc họp này có mục đích gì nhỉ?

definition: a feeling that you are proud of something you or someone connected with you has done (pride in + something)
exampleSentence: He takes great pride in his children's achievements.
exampleTranslation: Ông ấy rất tự hào về thành tích của các con.

definition: a situation that causes difficulties (problem with + something)
exampleSentence: I've been having a few problems with my car.
exampleTranslation: Dạo này xe của tôi có vài vấn đề.

definition: a difficult situation that needs to be dealt with (problem of + something)
exampleSentence: The problem of street crime is getting worse every year.
exampleTranslation: Vấn nạn tội phạm đường phố ngày càng tệ hơn mỗi năm.

definition: a series of actions done in order to achieve a result (process of + something/-ing)
exampleSentence: We are in the process of changing our accounting system.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi đang trong quá trình thay đổi hệ thống kế toán.

definition: the process of getting better at doing something or getting closer to finishing it (progress in + something/-ing)
exampleSentence: There has been significant progress in controlling heart disease.
exampleTranslation: Đã có tiến bộ đáng kể trong việc kiểm soát bệnh tim.

definition: a statement that you will definitely do or provide something (promise of + something)
exampleSentence: We received promises of support from several MPs.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi nhận được lời hứa ủng hộ từ vài nghị sĩ.

definition: the state of being kept safe from something (protection from + something)
exampleSentence: This jacket gives good protection from the rain and wind.
exampleTranslation: Chiếc áo khoác này bảo vệ tốt khỏi mưa và gió.

definition: the state of being kept safe from something harmful (protection against + something)
exampleSentence: Some studies say vitamin C gives protection against colds.
exampleTranslation: Một số nghiên cứu cho rằng vitamin C bảo vệ cơ thể chống cảm lạnh.
